notes.title: New Randomizer Features
notes.notes:
[p]The Item Randomizer has gained some additional features! [/p][p][/p][p]But first if you haven't heard [/p][p]Frogmonster got Archipelago Randomizer support earlier this year! It's an interesting way to play where any item pickup will give you something else instead adding some variety for people who have already experienced the game. Archipelago also has support for multiworld randomizers so you can unlock items for your friends in Frogmonster or even other games! It's a pretty cool thing that I'd recommend checking out if you haven't already. [/p][p]And if you need some help setting up join the discord for some better information[/p][p][/p][p]RANDOMIZER CHANGES[/p][p]-Orchus key can now be randomly obtained! This is a great way to add some more  variety to the runs and put some more importance on end game for required items.
-Bins's wokshop key can now be randomized
-Fixed a bunch of text related issues when rendering usernames [/p][p]-Fixed deathlink error message issues[/p][p]-Upgraded some networking stuff to make it compatible with AP 6[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone! [/p][p]Ben[/p]

notes.title: Frogmonster Item Randomizer!
notes.notes:
You can now play the game with items randomized! 

What does  this mean?
Weapons, spells, bugs, and most items you collect in the game have their sources swapped. So a catching a fly at the beginning of the game could give you the wooden cannon or any other item!

You can even play with friends! With multiword support you can have your item pools randomized together so one player can unlock items for another's! Even between different games entirely.

Additional features
-Multiword 
-Randomized bug on eat effects
-Difficulty settings
-Alternative goals
-Start with portals open

How do I play?
There are two steps to get it working! 

1) if you are hosting you are going to need to download the archipelago client and go through some steps to host a world either locally or on their website. There are great instructions for this from a community member who has helped me with the archipelago side of things

Better instructions found here! 
https://github.com/Rooby-Roo/FrogmonsterAPWorld/tree/main

2) The next step is to right click on Frogmonster in your steam library and click Properties->Betas and select the rando_0.1.0 branch! Once it's downloaded you can launch the game and pick a new save file.  After clicking play open the console and type in your archipelago connect command and name and you are all set!

Quick note
SAVE FILES ARE DIFFERENT FOR RANDO SO DON'T WORRY IF YOUR PREVIOUS SAVES DON'T SHOW UP

I've been having a blast playing this with some friends and hope you do too! 
Frogmonster is on sale until the end of spring sale so if you got some friends you want to rando with it's a great time to pick the game up! 

If you have any issues or questions feel free to join the discord or post on the steam forums

Thanks everybody hope you enjoy
-Ben

[/list]

Quality of life improvements
